# Copilot guidance

Follow the repository rulebook in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Keep changes small, typed, tested, and consistent with [`PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`](../PROJECT_CONTEXT.md). Read [`docs/PROGRESS.md`](../docs/PROGRESS.md) before starting work and update the progress and learning logs after a completed checkpoint.

Never execute submitted code in the backend process, expose AI credentials to the client, or claim tests passed without running them.
